corrections.placement_summary: China 2022 national progression is verified at learning-stage level. Revised PEP exact unit placement is verified across the series, including Grade 1 upper 11～20的认识, Grade 1 lower 100以内数的认识 and 100以内的笔算加、减法, Grade 2 lower 万以内数的认识/加法和减法, and Grade 4 upper 万以上数的认识.
China 2022 stage requirements are verified. Revised PEP places formal multiplication meaning/facts in Grade 2 upper through 1～6的表内乘法 and 7～9的表内乘、除法, with later multiplication methods in Grades 3-5.
China 2022 stage requirements are verified. Revised PEP exact placement includes Grade 3 upper 分数的初步认识 and Grade 5 lower 分数的认识.
China 2022 fraction relationships are verified. Revised PEP places the broader formal fraction-relationship work in Grade 5 lower 分数的认识; current secondary detail explicitly includes 分数基本性质.
China 2022 places area in the Grades 3-4 learning stage. Revised PEP exact placement includes Grade 3 lower 图形的面积, with current teacher-guide detail covering 面积和面积单位 and 长方形、正方形面积.
